name: @repo/kinetic-type-scroll
description: A KineticTypeScroll text animation component for SmoothUI.

useCases: Editorial scroll-driven phrases that scale and breathe per word
Section headers in long-form scrolling stories
Variable-font showcases tying weight to scroll position
compositionHints: Must sit inside a scrollable container; pass its ref via `container`
Use a variable font for `weightRange` to have a visible effect
